title: OrgProvisioningChangeResponseDataType
description: Response for OrgUnit Upsert provisioning requests.

code.description: Outcome code: OK, ORG_NOT_FOUND, or ERROR.

description.description:
Human readable explanation of the code. Examples:
- OK: The information about deleting the organization has been registered.
- ORG_NOT_FOUND: The organization with the specified id does not exist.
- ERROR: An internal error occurred; see errorMessage for stack trace.

errorMessage.description: Optional error details or stack trace when code is ERROR.
